interpretation: Registry status and listed arms do not establish dosing or efficacy.

trials.title: Osimertinib and Navitoclax in Treating Patients With EGFR-Positive Previously Treated Advanced or Metastatic Non-small Cell Lung Cancer

arms.label: Treatment (navitoclax, osimertinib)
arms.description: Patients receive navitoclax PO QD on days 1-28 and osimertinib PO QD on days 4-28 (days 1-28 during dose-expansion). Cycles repeat every 28 days in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity

trials.title: Study to Evaluate VT3989 in Patients With Metastatic Solid Tumors

arms.label: VT3989 Dose Escalation [Not Recruiting]
arms.description: VT3989 dosed orally in 21 or 28 day cycles. Patients will be enrolled into escalating dose levels during the Dose Escalation Phase

arms.label: Dose Expansion [Not Recruiting]
arms.description: VT3989 dosed in 21 or 28 day cycles in patients with refractory metastatic solid tumors or mesothelioma.

arms.label: Combination [Recruiting]
arms.description: For Cohort A and B, VT3989 dosed in 28 day cycles in patients with metastatic solid tumors or mesothelioma, in combination with immunotherapy (nivolumab/ipilimumab) or targeted therapy (osimertinib). For Cohort C, VT3989 dosed in 21 day cycles in patients with mesothelioma in combination with chemotherapy (pemetrexed+carboplatin) for 4-6 cycles, then continuing VT3989 as monotherapy on 28-day cycle.

trials.title: Osimertinib and Tegavivint as First-Line Therapy for the Treatment of Metastatic EGFR-Mutant Non-small Cell Lung Cancer

arms.label: Treatment (osimertinib, tegavivint)
arms.description: Patients receive osimertinib PO QD on days 1-28 and tegavivint IV on day 1. Treatment repeats every 28 days for 4 cycles in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. Patients then receive osimertinib PO QD on days 1-28. Treatment repeats every 28 days for 4 cycles in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.
